criterion: The evidence record references the authority and lets a verifier recompute the binding; it never re-asserts the authority as its own.

reject_reasons.reasserts_authority: the evidence record carries mandate members or the mandate itself, instead of referencing it by digest
reject_reasons.mandate_reference_mismatch: the record's mandate_hash is not the digest of the referenced mandate
reject_reasons.mandate_signature_invalid: the referenced mandate's issuer signature does not verify
reject_reasons.binding_mismatch: the binding recomputed from the referenced mandate and the record's paymentId is not the record's nonce
reject_reasons.payload_nonce_mismatch: the record's nonce is not the nonce in the signed payment authorization
reject_reasons.correlation_hash_mismatch: correlation_hash does not recompute from the record's correlation core

authority_note: authority_expect is the #3220 section 6 single-payment verdict (checks 1, 3 to 7), reported beside the criterion and never part of it: authority belongs to the x402 side.
